note: Input for tools/build.py sources. hig: the 88 archived macOS HIG pages retrieved for this spec (Wayback Machine snapshots of 3-4 May 2020, before macOS 11 was announced), with the exact snapshot each was read from. appkit: Apple developer documentation pages for the API symbols named in the component specs, confirmed to exist through the documentation site's JSON endpoint on 2026-10-01, with the macOS availability each page reports.

NSWindow.abstract: A window that an app displays on the screen.

NSButton.abstract: A control that defines an area on the screen that a user clicks to trigger an action.

NSColor.abstract: An object that stores color data and sometimes opacity (alpha value).

NSTextField.abstract: Text the user can select or edit to send an action message to a target when the user presses the Return key.

NSSegmentedControl.abstract: Display one or more buttons in a single horizontal group.

NSToolbar.abstract: An object that manages the space above your app’s custom content and either below or integrated with the window’s title bar.

NSScrollView.abstract: A view that displays a portion of a document view and provides scroll bars that allow the user to move the document view within the scroll view.

NSOutlineView.abstract: A view that uses a row-and-column format to display hierarchical data like directories and files that can be expanded and collapsed.

NSImage.abstract: A high-level interface for manipulating image data.

NSVisualEffectView.abstract: A view that adds translucency and vibrancy effects to the views in your interface.

NSTableView.abstract: A set of related records, displayed in rows that represent individual records and columns that represent the attributes of those records.

NSApplication.abstract: An object that manages an app’s main event loop and resources used by all of that app’s objects.

NSTextView.abstract: A view that draws text and handles user interactions with that text.

NSPopUpButton.abstract: A control for selecting an item from a list.

NSPanel.abstract: A special kind of window that typically performs a function that is auxiliary to the main window.

NSMenu.abstract: An object that manages an app’s menus.

NSImageView.abstract: A display of image data in a frame.

NSView.abstract: The infrastructure for drawing, printing, and handling events in an app.

NSSplitView.abstract: A view that arranges two or more views in a linear stack running horizontally or vertically.

NSToolbarItem.abstract: A single item that appears in a window’s toolbar.

NSSlider.abstract: A display of a bar representing a continuous range of numerical values and a knob representing the currently selected value.

NSSearchField.abstract: A text field optimized for performing text-based searches.

NSProgressIndicator.abstract: An interface that provides visual feedback to the user about the status of an ongoing task.

NSMenuItem.abstract: A command item in an app menu.

NSFont.abstract: The representation of a font in an app.

NSCollectionView.abstract: An ordered collection of data items displayed in a customizable layout.

NSWorkspace.abstract: A workspace that can launch other apps and perform a variety of file-handling services.

NSUserNotification.abstract: A notification that can be scheduled for display in the notification center.

NSTitlebarAccessoryViewController.abstract: An object that manages a custom view—known as an accessory view—in the title bar–toolbar area of a window.

NSTabView.abstract: A multipage interface that displays one page at a time.

NSStatusBar.abstract: An object that manages a collection of status items displayed within the system-wide menu bar.

NSSavePanel.abstract: A panel that prompts the user for information about where to save a file.

NSBox.abstract: A stylized rectangular box with an optional title.

NSAlert.abstract: A modal dialog or sheet attached to a document window.

WKWebView.abstract: An object that displays interactive web content, such as for an in-app browser.

UNUserNotificationCenter.abstract: The central object for managing notification-related activities for your app or app extension.

UNNotificationRequest.abstract: A request to schedule a local notification, which includes the content of the notification and the trigger conditions for delivery.

UNNotification.abstract: The data for a local or remote notification the system delivers to your app.

SFAuthorizationViewUnlockedState.abstract: Indicates that the state is unlocked

SFAuthorizationViewLockedState.abstract: Indicates that the state is locked

SFAuthorizationViewInProgressState.abstract: Indicates that the state is in progress

SFAuthorizationView.abstract: The class responsible for displaying a lock icon that can be used to indicate that a user interface has restricted access.

QLPreviewView.abstract: A Quick Look preview of an item that you can embed into your view hierarchy.

QLPreviewPanel.abstract: A class that implements the Quick Look preview panel to display a preview of a list of items.

NSWindowTabGroup.abstract: A group of windows that display together as a single tabbed window.

NSWindowTab.abstract: A tab associated with a window that is part of a tabbing group.

NSTokenField.abstract: A text field that converts text into visually distinct tokens.

NSTableRowView.abstract: The view shown for a row in a table view.

NSTableHeaderView.abstract: An object that draws headers over a table view’s columns and handles mouse events in those headers.

NSTableHeaderCell.abstract: An object that a table header view uses to draw the content of the column headers.

NSTableColumn.abstract: The display characteristics and identifier for a column in a table view.

NSTableCellView.abstract: A reusable container view shown for a particular cell in a table view that uses rows for content.

NSTabViewItem.abstract: An item in a tab view.

NSTabViewController.abstract: A container view controller that manages a tab view interface, which organizes multiple pages of content but displays only one page at a time.

NSSwitch.abstract: A control that offers a binary choice.

NSStepper.abstract: An interface with up and down arrow buttons for incrementing or decrementing a value.

NSStatusItem.abstract: An individual element displayed in the system menu bar.

NSSplitViewItem.abstract: An item in a split view controller.

NSSplitViewController.abstract: An object that manages an array of adjacent child views, and has a split view object for managing dividers between those views.

NSSmallSquareBezelStyle.abstract: A simple square bezel style. Buttons using this style can be scaled to any size.

NSSharingServicePickerToolbarItem.abstract: A toolbar item that displays the macOS share sheet.

NSSharingServicePicker.abstract: A list of sharing services that the user can choose from.

NSSecureTextFieldCell.abstract: A text field whose value is hidden from the user.

NSSecureTextField.abstract: A text field that hides the typed text.

NSSearchToolbarItem.abstract: A toolbar item that contains a search field optimized for performing text-based searches.

NSSearchFieldCell.abstract: The programmatic interface for text fields that are used for text-based searches.

NSScroller.abstract: An object that controls scrolling of a document view within a scroll view or other type of container view.

NSRulerView.abstract: A ruler and the markers above or to the side of a scroll view’s document view.

NSRulerMarker.abstract: A symbol on a ruler view, indicating a location for the graphics element it represents in the client of the ruler view.

NSRuleEditor.abstract: An interface for configuring a rule-based list of options.

NSRoundedBezelStyle.abstract: A rounded rectangle button, designed for text.

NSResponder.abstract: An abstract class that forms the basis of event and command processing in AppKit.

NSRegularSquareBezelStyle.abstract: A rectangular button with a two-point border, designed for icons.

NSPrintPanel.abstract: The Print panel that queries the user for information about a print job.

NSPrintOperation.abstract: An object that controls operations that generate Encapsulated PostScript (EPS) code, Portable Document Format (PDF) code, or print jobs.

NSPredicateEditor.abstract: A defined set of rules that allows the editing of predicate objects.

NSPopover.abstract: A means to display additional content related to existing content on the screen.

NSPopUpButtonCell.abstract: The  class defines the visual appearance of pop-up buttons that display pop-up or pull-down menus. Pop-up menus present the user with a set of choices, much the way radio buttons do, but using much less space. Pull-down menus also provide a set of choices but present the information in a slightly different way, usually to provide a set of commands from which the user can choose.

NSPathControl.abstract: A display of a file system path or virtual path information.

NSPageController.abstract: An object that controls swipe navigation and animations between views or view content.

NSOpenPanel.abstract: A panel that prompts the user to select a file to open.

NSMenuToolbarItem.abstract: A control that presents a menu in a window’s toolbar.

NSLevelIndicator.abstract: A visual representation of a level or quantity, using discrete values.

NSHelpButtonBezelStyle.abstract: A round button with a question mark providing the standard help button look.

NSDrawer.abstract: A user interface element that contains and displays text, scroll, and browser views, in addition to other view subclasses.

NSDockTile.abstract: The visual representation of your app’s miniaturized windows and app icon as they appear in the Dock.

NSDisclosureBezelStyle.abstract: A bezel style for use with a disclosure triangle.

NSDatePicker.abstract: A display of a calendar date with controls for editing the date value.

NSComboBoxCell.abstract: The user interface of a combo box.

NSComboBox.abstract: A view that displays a list of values in a pop-up menu where the user selects a value or types in a custom value.

NSColorWell.abstract: A control that displays a color value and lets the user change that color value.

NSCollectionViewItem.abstract: The visual representation for a single data element in a collection view.

NSCollectionViewFlowLayout.abstract: A layout that organizes items into a flexible and configurable arrangement.

NSCircularBezelStyle.abstract: A round button with room for a small icon or a single character.

NSCell.abstract: A mechanism for displaying text or images in a view object without the overhead of a full  subclass.

NSBrowser.abstract: An interface that displays a hierarchically organized list of data items that can be navigated and selected.

NSApplicationDelegate.abstract: A set of methods that manage your app’s life cycle and its interaction with common system services.

NSAppearance.abstract: An object that manages standard appearance attributes for UI elements in an app.

NCWidgetProviding.abstract: The interface for customizing the appearance and behavior of a Today widget.

AVPlayerView.abstract: A view that displays content from a player and presents a native user interface to control playback.

AVPictureInPictureController.abstract: A controller that responds to user-initiated Picture in Picture playback of video in a floating, resizable window.
